source.authority: Runtime CSS; this sidecar and DESIGN.md are derived records.
source.previewGeneration: Component CSS extracted from shared source, using inherited CSS custom properties. Regenerate after source changes; do not edit a preview palette independently.
source.migration: Shared paper-and-ink tokens style authentication, owner and student workspaces, friend exams, and reports. Android translates the same roles through native Material 3.
source.nativeBoundary: Android keeps Material 3 components, navigation, safe areas, and light/dark themes while sharing the paper, ink, and restrained signal palette.

narrative.northStar: A paper grid for focused study
narrative.overview: MockTaste is a laptop-hosted study and exam workspace styled as a quiet analog working surface. Paper, ink, mono annotations, and small functional color signals make tasks easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: Warm gray canvas with a subtle 24px hairline grid
Near-black ink and restrained, shadow-free white surfaces
Mono uppercase navigation, labels, and actions
Signal colors reserved for status and inline emphasis

rules.name: Paper and Ink
rules.body: Use canvas, paper, mist, hairline, and ink roles across all web surfaces.

rules.name: Signal Restraint
rules.body: Keep green and ember tied to functional state; use yellow only for inline highlighting.

rules.name: Flat Work Sheets
rules.body: Use fine borders and paper contrast; avoid shadows, glass, and gradients.

rules.name: Runtime Authority
rules.body: Keep documentation and examples derived from runtime tokens and components.

dos: Use Arial or system sans for body reading and mono type for uppercase interface annotations.
Keep sign-in and account creation on the same panel, fields, and black action.
Preserve visible focus, native semantics, readable mobile content, and reduced motion.
Keep Android native Material 3 and adapt the palette through its theme roles.
donts: Add feature-specific colors, gradients, shadows, blur, or unrelated typefaces.
Use green, ember, or yellow as broad surface fills or primary action colors.
Apply web layout treatments to native Android components.
